playstyle: Four Stormcast hunters: three 4-wound fighters on a single shield save at Move 3, plus Sleek, a fast but fragile minion that dodges and ensnares once Inspired. Every fighter except Sleek has a range 3 ranged attack, so the warband chips at foes from distance while Staggering melee strikes set up follow-ups. It has no warscroll of its own and borrows a generic Order one, which Inspires it either for holding treasure in enemy territory or for attacking from home ground. It wins through steady ranged attrition and objective control.
